t: This LAP 2G switched socket features 2 x Type C USB ports delivering up to 65W of power. Ideal for home offices, kitchens, and commercial workspaces, it allows users to charge laptops, tablets, and smartphones directly from the wall without bulky adapters. Smart power sharing technology automatically optimises output when charging multiple devices. The durable white moulded casing has a raised rounded profile and includes colour-coded angled terminals with captive screws to ensure a fast, straightforward installation for electricians and trade professionals.
b: Colour-Coded Angled In-Line Terminals with Captive Screws
